commands: set -euo pipefail; printf '%s\n' '=== applications ==='; ls -la /Applications | grep -i kicad || true; printf '%s\n' '=== kicad candidates ==='; find /Applications -maxdepth 5 \( -iname 'KiCad.app' -o -iname 'pcbnew.app' -o -name 'kicad-cli' -o -name 'pcbnew' \) -print 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,120p'
set -euo pipefail; printf '%s\n' '=== spotlight ==='; mdfind "kMDItemFSName == 'KiCad.app'c || kMDItemFSName == 'pcbnew.app'c || kMDItemFSName == 'kicad-cli'c" | sed -n '1,120p' || true

set -euo pipefail; printf '%s\n' '=== executable probes ==='; for p in /Applications/KiCad/KiCad.app/Contents/MacOS/kicad-cli /Applications/KiCad/KiCad.app/Contents/MacOS/kicad /Applications/KiCad/pcbnew.app/Contents/MacOS/pcbnew /Applications/KiCad/KiCad.app/Contents/Frameworks/Python.framework/Versions/*/bin/python3; do if test -e "$p"; then ls -l "$p"; "$p" --version 2>&1 || true; fi; done

set -euo pipefail; printf '%s\n' '=== python modules ==='; for py in python3 /usr/bin/python3 /opt/homebrew/bin/python3 /Library/Frameworks/Python.framework/Versions/3.12/bin/python3; do if command -v "$py" >/dev/null 2>&1 || test -x "$py"; then echo "--- $py"; "$py" --version 2>&1 || true; "$py" -c 'import importlib.util; print("skidl", importlib.util.find_spec("skidl")); print("pcbnew", importlib.util.find_spec("pcbnew"))' 2>&1 || true; "$py" -m pip show skidl 2>&1 | sed -n '1,40p' || true; fi; done

set -euo pipefail; printf '%s\n' '=== embedded module candidates ==='; find /Applications /Library/Frameworks -maxdepth 8 \( -name 'pcbnew.py' -o -name '_pcbnew*.so' -o -path '*/site-packages/skidl*' \) -print 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,160p'; printf '%s\n' '=== final git status ==='; git status --short
